title: Ask for one scalar
summary: Suspend the current logical task while the creator chooses one typed scalar value. The collector itself never changes the Project.

carrier.notes: Reached through luc_invoke after discovery and description. Schemas describe the result before the wrapper; Runtime context and authority are supplied separately by the Host.

replaceability.why: interaction/v1 is an open data protocol. The Host owns the surface, primitive validation, continuation and confirmation machinery. A layer cannot acquire authority beyond the manifest boundary.

reach.notes: The Host retains account/session binding and human confirmation. Optional Host APIs remain optional, not effective grants. The operation has no access to the editor native bridge.

operations.name: collect
operations.notes: No fixed human-wait deadline is enforced. invoke waits on the current interaction event. A new invocation is not idempotent and a second pending interaction in the same Session is refused. Submission_id receipts belong to the Host submission path, not to this invoke input. The original collector returns completed or cancelled after the wait; draft is the shared submission shape. It never applies a Project edit.

events.name: luc_interaction_state
events.notes: The Runtime stores and publishes the same state projection; binding and continuation remain Host-owned.

bounds.name: agent_result_chars
bounds.unit: characters before the model result is clipped; the cut notice is appended

bounds.name: state_bytes
bounds.unit: UTF-8 bytes for new durable Session interaction state

invariants.text: The collector has editable none; accepting its value does not authorize or apply a Project change.

break: Context, task, account, Project revision or target binding is no longer current.
Primitive validation, state persistence, preview or confirmed apply fails.
failure.notes: Cancellation resumes with {status: cancelled}; a failure invalidates preview and releases the wait with its error. There is no operation-level automatic layer-to-original retry at this interaction seam.

conformance.notes: Existing tests were inspected, not executed. Structural checking does not establish live availability, GUI acceptance or replacement conformance.
